source_title: G.S. 58-57-40, Credit life insurance rate standards (North Carolina General Assembly)
plan: Single premium decreasing term (equal monthly installments), single life
basis: per one hundred dollars ($100.00) of indebtedness per year
rate_table_note: Rates are the last steps of G.S. 58-57-40(c) and (e), "Effective January 1, 1997" (earlier steps 1995 and 1996). Joint is at most 1 2/3 times single (d); monthly outstanding balance rates follow the formula in (f); a nonrefundable origination fee of $1.00 or $3.00 is allowed (h). History: 1975, c. 660; 1987, c. 826; 1991, c. 720; 1993, c. 226, s. 7.
summary: Rates in force: North Carolina's credit life rate standards in G.S. 58-57-40: 50 cents per $100 per year single premium decreasing term and $1.10 per $100 per year level term, effective January 1, 1997. Set by statute, so a change needs legislation.

basis: per one hundred dollars ($100.00) per year

source_title: G.S. 58-57-45, Credit accident and health insurance rate standards (North Carolina General Assembly)
rate_table_note: Rates are the single premium table in G.S. 58-57-45(d), by months (12 to 120) and nonretroactive (14-, 30-day) or retroactive (7-, 14-, 30-day) benefits; rows 12 and 60 recorded. Joint is at most 1 2/3 times single (h). The section was rewritten by S.L. 1993-226, s. 8; s. 18 of that act makes it effective January 1, 1994 (saved as NC-SL1993-226.html). Credit unemployment rates are filed and approved (G.S. 58-57-35).
summary: Rates in force: North Carolina's credit accident and health rate standards in G.S. 58-57-45, single premium per $100 of initial insured indebtedness for 12 and 60 months, since the section's rewrite effective January 1, 1994. Set by statute.
